In detail

Avon and Somerset Constabulary recorded 34 crimes inside this ward's official boundary over the 3 months to July 2026 — 3.7 per 1,000 residents, the 30th highest rate of Bath's 33 wards. The daytime score here is driven by burglary (1), vehicle crime (1); the evening/night score by violent crime (4), anti social behaviour (3). Rated against the average of the city's own wards, never against another city.

Frequently asked questions

Is High Littleton safe?

Wandroz currently rates High Littleton in Bath as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Bath during the day and relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Bath at night. This rating is derived from Avon and Somerset Constabulary street-level crime records published at data.police.uk — an official statistic, not an assessment. High-footfall tourist, transit or shopping areas can read higher on this kind of measure without that meaning elevated risk per visit, since these statistics are normalised against registered residents rather than footfall — see the note on this page and the methodology page for the full caveats.

Is High Littleton safe at night?

At night, High Littleton is rated as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Bath. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is High Littleton a good area to stay in as a tourist?

High Littleton's day rating (roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Bath) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late.
